analysis.summary: Management reported a 3% growth in reported revenues for FY19, with international revenues crossing the $20 million milestone following a 54% growth. Domestic business was impacted in Q4 by severe weather conditions, though consumption has since reverted to historical trends with double-digit growth in the summer season. The company plans to incur regular capital expenditure of approximately Rs. 30-35 crore during the year while continuing to focus on debt rationalization and margin expansion. Vadilal Industries reported robust financial and operational performance for Q3 and 9M FY19, driven by strong growth in domestic volumes and rapid expansion in international markets.

guidance.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on capital expenditure during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver double-digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: The company expects another good year in FY20 by leveraging the Vadilal brand.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

guidance.claim: Management maintains a positive business outlook driven by consumption, organized sector demand shift, and international traction.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $20 million milestone driven by strong demand from the Indian diaspora in the U.S. and other geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19. International business is now over 25% of revenues and growth is driven by strong demand for our high quality ice creams and other products within the sizeable Indian diaspora community in the U.S. and some other geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double-digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is now reverting to historical trends.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted strong growth in demand in international markets and is looking to penetrate deeper to address gaps in availability.
demand_outlook.quote: Based on the strong growth in demand, we are looking to penetrate deeper into these markets to address the gap in the availability of Indian products to the community.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic ice cream volumes grew by 6% during Q2, driven by consumer preference and distribution expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q2, we have continued our strong business momentum to expand ice cream volumes by 6.9%, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in the international business.

demand_outlook.claim: International ice cream and processed food products experienced positive demand pull from the Indian diaspora.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues contributed 32% to the turnover during Q2 and continue to expand rapidly with Vadilal ice cream and processed foods products finding positive demand pull from the Indian diaspora in the US and other key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Raw material prices for the next season continue to be subdued.
demand_outlook.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

capex_expansion.claim: Distribution investments have been committed in multiple locations in the U.S.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already committed distribution investments in multiple locations in the U.S. that allow us widespread access to the sizeable Indian diaspora in key target markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY 20 is approximately Rs. 30 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 20 at ~ Rs. 30 crore

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote:  No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and international operations.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, driven by U.S. operations with over 50 employees.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: Visibility of stable costs is covered till Q2 based on raw material purchase and inventory position.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: Prices will be looked to be increased in the second half of the year as milk prices are at higher levels now.
margins_costs.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have continued to expand – gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: On a nine-month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.
margins_costs.quote: On nine month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin increased by over 1,000 bps during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Margin improvements were achieved through volume growth, existing capacity utilization, lower raw material prices, and operating cost discipline.
margins_costs.quote: This is in line with the recent trend of expansion and has been achieved through volume growth by utilizing existing capacities, lower raw material procurement prices and operating cost discipline.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity was expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates production facilities with specific capacities including 150,000 liters per day at Bareilly.
orders_capacity.quote: Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh 150,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005

orders_capacity.claim: The Dharampur facility has a capacity of 33,000 kgs per day for processed foods.
orders_capacity.quote: Dharampur, Gujarat 33,000 kgs per day Processed foods ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6

orders_capacity.claim: The Pundhra facility has an ice cream capacity of 230,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Pundhra, Gujarat 230,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal products currently reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states and we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.

orders_capacity.claim: Total production capacity stands at 380,000 liters per day across facilities.
orders_capacity.quote:  Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
orders_capacity.quote:  No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capital_allocation.claim: Outstanding debt was reconstituted to increase long tenure loans and reduce the cost of debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions extending the winter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.
